selection: One second clip from each source group whose first clip passed STANDARD.
reviewMethod: GPT direct whole-source visual review using dense 10 fps evidence; no sibling clip inherits a pass from its source group.
importantFinding: UCF101 source groups are not subtype-pure. g03 and g24 had STANDARD c01 clips but non-STANDARD c02 clips, so every clip must be visually typed independently.

rows.reason: Single jumper; ordinary uncrossed single-rope rotations with synchronized two-foot bounce remain consistent through the full clip.
